name: Ken
description: Ken — a production MERN TypeScript AI chatbot platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @Ken/shared" "npm run dev -w @Ken/server" "npm run dev -w @Ken/client"
scripts.server: npm run build -w @Ken/shared && npm run dev -w @Ken/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @Ken/shared && npm run build -w @Ken/server && npm run build -w @Ken/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @Ken/shared && npm run test -w @Ken/shared && npm run test -w @Ken/server && npm run test -w @Ken/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @Ken/shared && npm run lint -w @Ken/server && npm run lint -w @Ken/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @Ken/shared && npm run build -w @Ken/shared && npm run typecheck -w @Ken/server && npm run typecheck -w @Ken/client
